findings.current:
Morgoth had never understood their behavior.

They would burn down a few cities and destroy an entire kingdom, then come all the way to his lair to make a scene over it.
findings.defect: The draft makes the heroes burn the cities and destroy the kingdom. Morgoth did those things; the heroes came to his lair in response.
findings.rationale: The complaint is Morgoth’s: he considers his own destruction a trivial reason for the heroes to confront him.
findings.replacement:
Morgoth could never quite understand their behavior.

All he had done was burn a few cities and wipe out a kingdom, and they came all the way to his lair to make a scene.
findings.source:
모르고스는 그들의 행동을 좀처럼 이해하지 못했다.

고작 도시 몇 개를 불태우고, 왕국 하나를 없앴다고 자신의 레어까지 찾아와 행패를 부리다니.

findings.current: If hit directly, even a fellow Dragon couldn’t have avoided serious injury.
findings.defect: “Serious injury” understates 치명상, a potentially fatal wound.
findings.rationale: The severity of Morgoth’s spell establishes why Jin’s survival alarms him.
findings.replacement: A direct hit would have left even another Dragon with a potentially fatal wound.
findings.source: 직격당한다면 동족인 드래곤조차 치명상을 피할 수 없을 정도의 마법.

findings.current:
> **System**
>
> You defeated [Lv. 98 Enhanced Minotaur Warrior]!
>
> You defeated [Lv. 110 Enhanced Twin-Headed Ogre]!
>
> You defeated [Lv. 120 Enhanced Death Knight]!
>
> ……
>
> EXP gained is reduced based on the level difference!
>
> You gained a small amount of EXP!
findings.defect: The EXP reduction depends on a difference in strength, not specifically a level difference. The notices also retain prohibited square brackets.
findings.rationale: 힘의 격차 specifies a strength gap. The binding System format excludes square brackets around notice terms.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
>
> You defeated the Lv. 98 Enhanced Minotaur Warrior!
>
> You defeated the Lv. 110 Enhanced Twin-Headed Ogre!
>
> You defeated the Lv. 120 Enhanced Death Knight!
>
> …
>
> EXP gained is reduced due to the difference in strength!
>
> You gained a small amount of EXP!

findings.rationale: The framed System panel identifies these notices without square brackets.

> **System**
>
> You have met the activation requirements for One Against a Thousand!
>
> The enemies are greatly intimidated by the effect of the Title One Against a Thousand!

> Intimidation has greatly increased due to the effect of the Title One Against a Thousand!

-칭호, [일기당천]의 효과로 인해 적들이 크게 위축됩니다!

-칭호, [일기당천]의 효과로 인해 [위압]이 크게 증가합니다!

summary: One action is reversed, and two combat-mechanics details are misstated. Both System panels also retain brackets prohibited by the binding format.
